high_level_description: The image depicts the Dr. M.G.R. Centenary Arch, a prominent landmark located in Chennai, India. The arch is a large, ornate structure with a classical design, featuring intricate carvings and decorative elements. It is painted in a light beige color with white accents, giving it a grand and majestic appearance. The arch spans over a wide road that curves gently to the right. The road appears to be well-maintained, with clear lane markings and a smooth surface.
